body.name: Separate scalar-bound regret correspondence
body.construction: Set \(\underline J_m=\inf_{v\in\mathcal V(p_{BT},q)}v_m\) and \(\overline J_m=\sup_{v\in\mathcal V(p_{BT},q)}v_m\). Define \(D^{\Box}_{mm}=0\), \(D^{\Box}_{mj}=\overline J_m-\underline J_j\) for \(m\ne j\), \(R_m^{\Box}=\max_{j\in\mathcal M}D^{\Box}_{mj}\), and \(\mathcal M^{\Box}=\operatorname*{argmin}_{m\in\mathcal M}R_m^{\Box}\).
